name: not_empty
title: Check an object doesn't have any empty dimensions

origin.description: Check an object doesn't have any empty dimensions.
origin.details: Uses dim when the object has one, and length otherwise. Any zero dimension is false. A zero-row data frame and a zero-column data frame are both empty. NA has length one and is not empty. NULL and numeric() are empty.

translation.description: Check an object doesn't have any empty dimensions.
translation.details: Uses dim when the object has one, and length otherwise. Any zero dimension is false. frame(nrow, ncol) stands in for a data frame. NA has length one and is not empty. None and an empty list are empty.
translation.example:
from assertthat import not_empty
from assertthat.assertions import frame

print(not_empty([]))
print(not_empty(frame(0, 11)))
print(not_empty(frame(32, 0)))
